_doc_user: Edit the copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\FactoryGame\Saved\FICSITRoles\FICSITRoles.json (created on first launch). A newer mod revision replaces it and keeps a .old backup.
_doc: Declarative division rules. Class names are matched without the _C suffix; a trailing * is a prefix match. A target listed by no division base and no tech node is common (everyone). Listed somewhere: only divisions whose base lists it, or whose researched node grants it, may do it. collect also accepts DropPod. Tech is paid instantly from the player inventory. Texts live in Resources/Localization. Design notes: docs/BALANCE.md.

_common._doc: Intentionally unused since rev 8: every target belongs to at least one division base (see tools/validate_config.py). Kept empty for documentation only.

renamed._doc: Save migration: "old.id": "new.id" for renamed/merged tech nodes or divisions. Never delete a shipped id without an entry here (see tools/ids.lock).
